description: This file defines the APIService class for handling HTTP requests using axios, including methods for CRUD operations and response interceptors, within a Vue.js application context.

classes.name: APIService
classes.description: A service class for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with axios, including response interceptors and error handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the APIService with base URL and API section, sets up axios instance and response interceptors.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all resources with optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a resource by ID with optional query parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new resource with provided data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a resource by ID with provided data.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes multiple resources, optionally with data payload.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a custom HTTP request with specified options.

methods.name: setupResponseInterceptors
methods.description: Sets up axios response interceptors for handling errors and showing toast notifications.

methods.name: apiSection
methods.description: Setter for the API section path.
